title: Implement V4 Linux-first trusted-base CI candidate
goal: Complete the dormant-base P6 CI authority, trusted runner, immutable artifact reuse, Windows selection and required-verdict negative controls without activating remote workflow or ruleset state.
acceptanceCriteria: The inactive workflow exposes stable v4-contract, v4-linux, v4-package and v4-required contexts with read-only permissions and cancellation.
A base-owned runner validates exact V4 Plan diff scope, executes the approved Linux suite without secrets and produces one hash-bound immutable artifact manifest.
Package and Windows jobs consume and verify the Linux-produced artifact rather than rebuilding or repackaging it.
A base-owned classifier selects Windows smoke for platform-sensitive paths and explicit full coverage for certification.
The required aggregator fails when mandatory Linux, package or selected Windows work is skipped or unsuccessful.
The candidate workflow and runner contain no IFX product, frontend, database or V3 candidate suite invocation.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged and no active workflow, ruleset, push or other remote mutation occurs.
